nodes.why: One question on the idea just taught. A missed answer goes to a simpler re-teach step, then back here. Never scored against anyone.

check.q: A diary written later describes an old event. Which date goes on the timeline?
options: The date the diary was written
The date of the event it describes
check.why: The timeline places the event; the writing date tells you about the source.
